tokens.note: ἀναπηδήσας has lemma=ἀναπηδάω in bible_data, not ἀνίστημι. G450 strong assignment is inconsistent with the lemma field. ja=立ち上がる is defensible for the physical action (jumping up) but the word is from a different root. Needs bible_data investigation.
ἄφετε en=let ~ alone. ἀφίημι here = "leave alone / stop bothering." 赦す (forgive/pardon) does not represent this meaning.
Ἄφες en=leave ~ alone. Same "leave/let alone" cluster. 赦す ≠ leave alone.
ἀφίημι en=leave. "Peace I leave with you." ἀφίημι = leave behind / bequeath. 赦す (forgive) is semantically wrong here.
ἀφεθήσεται en=left. "The other will be left behind." Eschatological "left behind" sense. 赦す (forgive) does not represent being left behind.
tokens.revisedCandidate: 残される・置き去りにされる

tokens.note: ἀφεὶς en=leaving. "Leaving them again" — leaving/departing sense. 赦す does not represent this.
ἀφέντες en=left. "They left their nets" — abandon/leave behind. 赦す (forgive) is semantically wrong.
ἀφέντες en=left. "They left the boat and their father" — abandon/leave. 赦す is wrong.
ἄφες en=let. "Let the dead bury their own dead." ἀφίημι = allow/permit. 赦す does not represent permitting.
ἀφίετε en=permit. "You no longer permit him to do anything for his father." ἀφίημι = permit/allow. 赦す ≠ permit.
ἀφέντες en=abandoned. "Having abandoned the natural function." ἀφίημι = abandon/forsake. 赦す (forgive) is semantically wrong.
δεῖ (V-PAI-3S) en=ought. Impersonal "it is necessary/binding." ja=縛る does not convey "must/ought" to a reader.
δεῖν (V-PAN) en=ought. Infinitive of impersonal δεῖ. ja=縛る does not convey "must/ought."
δεῖ (V-PAI-3S) en=must. "It is necessary that you must do." ja=縛る (bind) vs functional "must."
δεῖ (V-PAI-3S) en=must. "It is necessary for us to pay attention." ja=縛る does not convey obligation.
δεῖ (V-PAI-3S) en=must. "The Son of Man must be lifted up." Necessary/compelled sense. ja=縛る ≠ must.
Δεῖ (V-PAI-3S) en=must. "It is necessary for the Son of Man to suffer." ja=縛る does not convey necessity.
δεῖ (V-PAI-3S) en=must. "Which must soon take place." ja=縛る does not convey "must/soon."

δεόμενος (V-PNP-NSM) is from δέομαι (G1189 = beg/pray/ask), NOT δέω (G1210 = bind/tie). These are different words with different roots. ja=縛る does not represent en=asking. Strong number misassignment in bible_data.
ἔκρινα en=made up ~ mind. 2CO 2:1: "I made up my mind not to come to you." κρίνω = decide/determine. 裁く (judge) is a stretch for personal decision.
ἔκρινα en=decided. "I decided to appeal to Augustus." κρίνω = decide. 裁く (judicially judge) misrepresents a personal decision.
παραδοῖ en=ripe. MRK 4:29: "when the crop permits/yields." Agricultural idiom: the grain "hands itself over" for harvest = becomes ripe/ready. 引き渡す does not convey ripeness/readiness.
